S01: On the high royal pastures, a young shepherd kept the flock day and night.
S02: He would not let a single sheep stray.
S03: When night fell, he lit a fire and kept watch.
S05: One day, on the very pasture, something caught his eye.
S06: Among the rocks an entrance to a cave was opening.
S07: He descended and stood before the dark opening.
S08: Inside gleamed three doors: iron, silver and gold.
S10: Out of the darkness the monster leaped and attacked him.
S11: Without hesitation, the boy struck it.
S12: The monster fled, leaving an iron key behind.
S14: Shepherd: "This must be the key to the iron door."
S15: He put the key into the iron lock and turned it.
S16: The iron door opened onto a beautiful garden.
S17: Among the flowers he picked violets.
S18: From them he made a small bouquet.
S19: In the evening, with the flock and the bouquet, he descended toward the royal palace.
S21: The princess received it with a warm smile.
S22: All the sheep were accounted for — not one was missing.
S24: The monster attacked again, just as the first time.
S25: The shepherd struck it just as the day before.
S26: This time, a silver key remained behind it.
S29: The silver door unlocked with a single turn.
S30: Behind it was a garden even more beautiful than the first.
S32: Carefully he picked a few roses.
S33: And made a bouquet more beautiful than the first.
S34: In the evening he brought them to the palace, together with the flock.
S36: The whole palace marveled at the roses.
S37: And for the second time, not a single sheep was lost.
S38: And the third day came — the last.
S39: The monster came out for a final, terrible attack.
S40: The shepherd struck it with all his might.
S44: The golden door opened in a storm of light.
S45: Behind it waited a magnificent castle full of riches.
S46: Shepherd: "This will be my new home!"
S48: And they lived together in the golden castle.
